name: Optim Finance
description_short: Yield optimization suite for Cardano DeFi.
description_long: Decentralized suite of yield products on Cardano. Liquidity Bonds let SPOs and projects borrow ada staking rights on-chain while lenders earn a fixed return — used to bootstrap stake for new pools and ISPOs. OADA is a synthetic ada backed 1:1 and always redeemable, with sOADA for staking, giving holders yield plus DeFi composability. Leviathan, an L2 virtual ledger for Cardano with account-based transactions and fast finality, and OTOKEN Strategy Vaults for automated asset allocation are both announced but not yet live. Governance runs through the ODAO.
